title: Kulisusu language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Kulisusu is an Austronesian language of Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia. The Kulisusu language is spoken in the northern part of Buton Island. It is part of a dialect chain with two minor languages, Koroni and Taloki.
